messages:
alex: Heads up — proposing a conservative image cutover this Friday 02:00 UTC. Scope: switch runtime nodes to minimal rootfs image v3 (smaller attack surface + newest patches), rotate KMS signing key, and tighten push RBAC so only build-service can publish images. Need oncall + sec sign-off and a clear rollback plan.

alex: High-level plan:
- Canary deploy to 3% (us-west-2) -> 10% -> full.
- Keep old signing key as a verify-only alias for 48h after cutover.
- Terraform change for new role `image-custodian` + restrict iam:PassRole.
- Audit events: image:push, key:rotate, role:assume.

lina: Quick Q — will this require draining dedicated GPU pools?
sam: Yes, for the initial canary we'll do graceful drain on a few nodes. No full fleet reboot. Will add a pre-cutover maint window.

maria: Security notes: we need to ensure audit logs include the image digest and signer identity. Also add an alert for any unsigned-image-pull attempts.

ryan: If we rotate the KMS signing key, image verification code needs to try both aliases during the transition. Otherwise clients will reject signed manifests. Can we add fallback logic?
alex: Good point. Plan is: verification order: [current-key-alias, old-key-alias]. Keep old-key-alias enabled for 48h, then schedule a hard deprecate with notice.

alex: Sample tag/push commands for the pipeline:
```
# build and sign
docker build -t registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v3-{{CI_BUILD}} .
docker push registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v3-{{CI_BUILD}}
# sign step (attestation)
cosign sign --key kms://alias/redwood-image-signer registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v3-{{CI_BUILD}}
```

alex: RBAC terraform snippet (to be reviewed by infra+sec):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "image_custodian" {
  name = "image-custodian"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.custodian_assume.json
}
resource "aws_iam_policy" "image_push_policy" {
  name = "image-push-policy"
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{Action = ["ecr:PutImage","ecr:InitiateLayerUpload"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "*"}]
  })
}
```

devops-bot: pipeline queued: #12468 image-cutover-canary (triggered by alex) :gear:

irene: Contingency: if canary error rate > 2% for 15m -> auto rollback to v2 and block further promotions. Also add a postmortem template stub in case of degradation.

maria: Also: vulnerability triage — make sure SBOM for v3 is attached to the image metadata and scanned by our vuln service before canary. Any medium+ CVE must be triaged and documented.

sam: Ops checklist (short):
- confirm canary nodes reserved (done)
- pipeline secrets scoped to image-custodian (pending)
- datadog monitors for error rate + latency (in progress)

ryan: One more: update verification libs in SDKs to accept key aliases. I'll open PR in verifier repo.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 30min handoff on Thurs 16:00 UTC for final sign-off and will post the exact maint window. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend or reply with scheduling conflicts.
maria: :thumbsup:
lina: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
irene: can do
